concept: A continuous, differentiable curve that starts and ends at equal heights must have a flat tangent somewhere between.
lyrics_en: Start at a, you end at b, and the heights are the same,
f of a equals f of b — that's the opening frame.
Somewhere in the middle there's a point we call c,
where the tangent lies flat — f dash c is zero, you see!
lyrics_hi: a pe shuru, b pe end, dono height ek samaan,
f(a) barabar f(b) — yahi shart ka bayaan.
beech mein ek point aaya, usko bolo c,
tangent bilkul flat — f dash c zero, dekh zaraa!
lyrics_bhajan: He ganit-dev, suno vinti meri,
a aur b pe height ek — kirpa teri,
beech mein ek point c vidhaata ne banaaya,
f dash c zero — tangent flat, dhanya maaya.
lyrics_mr: a var suru, b var end, doghanchi height samaan,
f(a) barobar f(b) — hich aahe shart chi khoon.
madhe kuthe tari ek point, tyala mhana c,
tangent agadi flat — f dash c zero, bagha re!
lyrics_gu: a par shuru, b par end, banne ni height samaan,
f(a) barabar f(b) — aaj chhe shart nu bayaan.
vacche kyaank ek point aavyo, ene kaho c,
tangent tadan flat — f dash c zero, jo ne tu!
lyrics_bhajan_sa: Om ganita-devaaya namaha, shrnu me vinatim,
a cha b samaana-uchche, vande gurum param,
madhye kaschit binduhu c, budhaaha vadanti hi,
f dash c shunyam — tangent samatalam, jaya!

concept: Somewhere the instantaneous slope equals the average rate of change — tangent parallel to the secant.
lyrics_en: Average rate, now meet the slope at c,
f dash c equals f of b minus f of a over b minus a.
Tangent parallel to the line through the ends,
LMVT is the rule that never bends!
lyrics_hi: average rate se milti hai slope point c pe,
f dash c barabar f(b) minus f(a) over b minus a.
secant ke parallel wahi tangent ki line,
LMVT ka rule, sab kuch fine!
lyrics_bhajan: Sumiran karo, dhal rahi hai shaam,
average rate a se b — lo prabhu ka naam,
kahin point c pe slope wahi aaye,
tangent secant ke sang — bhakt gun gaaye.
lyrics_mr: average rate ne milte slope point c var,
f dash c barobar f(b) minus f(a) over b minus a.
secant la parallel techi tangent chi line,
LMVT cha niyam — sagle agadi fine!
lyrics_gu: average rate thi male chhe slope point c par,
f dash c barabar f(b) minus f(a) over b minus a.
secant ne parallel teji tangent ni line,
LMVT no niyam — badhu j fine!
lyrics_bhajan_sa: kutrachit binduhu c, tatra slope samaana,
tangent secant saha — jaya jaya gaana!

concept: Two functions compared by ratio — the bridge to L'Hôpital's rule.
lyrics_en: Two functions racing, compare the pace,
f dash c over g dash c — ratio in its place.
Net change over net change, equal they'll be,
building up the bridge to L'Hopital, see!
lyrics_hi: do functions ki race, ratio se tol,
f dash c over g dash c, yahi hai bol.
net change ka ratio barabar rahe,
L'Hopital tak ka pul yahi kahe!
lyrics_bhajan: Do functions f aur g, prabhu ki leela,
change by change ka bhed, mann sheetal keela,
point c pe f dash by g dash barabar,
Cauchy ka theorem — gaao sab milkar.
lyrics_mr: don functions chi shardat, ratio ne tola,
f dash c over g dash c — hech aahe bola.
net change cha ratio sarkha rahto,
L'Hopital paryant cha pul hach sangto!
lyrics_gu: be functions ni race, ratio thi tolo,
f dash c over g dash c — aaj chhe bolo.
net change no ratio sarkho rahe,
L'Hopital sudhi no pul aaj kahe!
lyrics_bhajan_sa: dve functione f cha g, leelaa-vilaasinim,
c binduau f dash by g dash samaana,

concept: Terms settle toward a limit L: past a threshold N they stay within any distance ε.
lyrics_en: Numbers drifting one by one, taking their time,
settling soft toward a limit, finding their line.
Past a threshold N, the terms stay within epsilon — home,
bounded and monotone, no more to roam.
lyrics_hi: numbers dheere dheere limit ki ore,
lim a-n barabar L, settle hote more.
N ke baad, terms epsilon ke andar rahe,
bounded aur monotone — converge yeh kahe.
lyrics_bhajan: He antaryaami, terms chalein L ki or,
epsilon ke andar — thaam lo meri dor,
N ke baad har term paas hi rahe,
yahi convergence — saadhu-sant kahe.
lyrics_mr: numbers halu halu limit kade,
lim a-n barobar L, settle hotat gade.
N nantar, terms epsilon madhe rahtat,
bounded ani monotone — converge he mhantat.
lyrics_gu: numbers dheere dheere limit taraf,
lim a-n barabar L, settle thata saraf.
N pachhi, terms epsilon ma rahe,
bounded ane monotone — converge e kahe.
lyrics_bhajan_sa: terms gacchanti L prati, epsilon madhye,

concept: Infinite sums tested with D'Alembert's ratio test and Cauchy's root test.
lyrics_en: Partial sums are climbing, do they stay or fly?
Run the ratio test to see if it's a lie.
L less than one they converge, greater than one goodbye,
Cauchy's root test checking as the terms go by.
lyrics_hi: partial sums chadhein, rukein ya udein?
ratio test lagao, sach keh dein.
L one se kam converge, one se zyada bye,
Cauchy root test bhi parakh le, try!
lyrics_bhajan: Anant jod ka sumiran din-raat,
ratio test lagaao — suno prabhu ki baat,
L ek se kam ho to sum thahar jaaye,
convergence ka vardaan bhakt ko mil jaaye.
lyrics_mr: partial sums chadhtat, thamtat ki udtat?
ratio test lava, satya sangun taktat.
L ekahun kami converge, ekahun jast bye,
Cauchy root test ne hi tapasun ghe, try!
lyrics_gu: partial sums chadhe, athave ude ke rahe?
ratio test lagaavo, sachu kahe.
L ek thi ochho converge, ek thi vadhu bye,
Cauchy root test thi y chakaso, try!
lyrics_bhajan_sa: ratio test kuru, shrnu prabho vachanam,
L ekasmaat nyoon — sum sthiram bhavati,

concept: Any smooth function expands into an infinite polynomial around a point a.
ref_en: Mark Ronson ft. Bruno Mars – ‘Uptown Funk’
lyrics_en: Expand around a, term on term they grow,
f of a plus f dash a times x minus a, let it flow.
Successive derivatives stacking the sum,
Taylor's polynomial till the series is done.
lyrics_hi: point a ke aas paas, term pe term,
f(a) plus f dash a into x minus a badhta firm.
derivatives ki layer, sum banti jaaye,
Taylor ki series, dhun gungunaaye.
lyrics_bhajan: Point a pe baitho, dhyaan lagaao,
har derivative ko n factorial se bhaao,
x minus a ki power n — jodte chalo,
Taylor ka saar — bhajan mein dhalo.
lyrics_mr: point a chya aajubajula, term var term,
f(a) plus f dash a into x minus a vadhta firm.
derivatives chya layer, sum banat jaate,
Taylor chi series, dhun gungunat jaate.
lyrics_gu: point a ni aaspaas, term par term,
f(a) plus f dash a into x minus a vadhe firm.
derivatives na layer, sum banti jaay,
Taylor ni series, dhun gungunaay.
lyrics_bhajan_sa: binduau a, pratyeka derivative n factorial,
x minus a power n — yogam karomi,

concept: Taylor's series centred at the origin a = 0 — the standard eˣ, sin, cos expansions.
lyrics_en: Same as Taylor but we center at zero,
unplug the guitar, let the simple be the hero.
e to the x equals one plus x plus x squared over two,
Maclaurin keeps it honest, keeps it true.
lyrics_hi: Taylor hi hai par center zero pe,
simple si dhun, acoustic saaye pe.
e to the x barabar one plus x plus x squared over two,
Maclaurin saaf-suthra, dil mein basa le.
lyrics_bhajan: a shunya pe rakho, origin hai dhaam,
f zero, f dash zero — lo iska naam,
e, sin, cos sab yahin se khilen,
Maclaurin ki mahima — bhakton ko milen.
lyrics_mr: Taylor ch aahe pan center zero var,
saadhi dhun, acoustic saavlit sundar.
e to the x barobar one plus x plus x squared over two,
Maclaurin swachh-nital, manaat basaav tu.
lyrics_gu: Taylor j chhe pan center zero par,
saadi dhun, acoustic chhaanya sundar.
e to the x barabar one plus x plus x squared over two,
Maclaurin chokhkhu, dil ma vasaavi lo tu.
lyrics_bhajan_sa: f zero, f dash zero — grhnaami naam,

concept: Limits whose direct value is undefined — need algebra or logs first.
lyrics_en: Zero over zero, infinity fight,
the form's a disguise, it won't give you the light.
Factor it, log it, rationalize the frame,
reveal the true limit — that's the funky game.
lyrics_hi: zero bata zero, infinity ki jung,
form dhoka deti, na mile rang.
factor karo, log karo, rationalize zaraa,
asli limit nikaalo — funky adaa!
lyrics_bhajan: Zero by zero, anant by anant,
seedha uttar na mile — suno vrttant,
pehle algebra ya log lagaao,
indeterminate ka parda hataao.
lyrics_mr: zero bhagile zero, infinity chi ladhai,
form fasavte, rang kahi na milai.
factor kara, log kara, rationalize kara,
khari limit kadha — funky ada dhara!
lyrics_gu: zero bhagya zero, infinity ni jang,
form chhetre, male nahi rang.
factor karo, log karo, rationalize karo,
saachi limit kaadho — funky ada dharo!
lyrics_bhajan_sa: zero by zero, ananta by ananta tanu,

concept: For 0/0 or ∞/∞, the ratio of limits equals the ratio of derivatives.
lyrics_en: Stuck on zero over zero? Don't you stall,
derivative on top and bottom, take them all.
Still indeterminate? Run it once more,
L'Hopital's the banger that settles the score!
lyrics_hi: zero over zero pe atke? mat ghabra,
upar neeche derivative, le le saara.
phir bhi indeterminate? dobaara chala,
L'Hopital banger, hisaab chuka!
lyrics_bhajan: Zero by zero mein mat ghabraao,
oopar neeche dono ka derivative laao,
ratio of limits — derivative ki jodi,
L'Hospital ka naam — bhakti thodi-thodi.
lyrics_mr: zero over zero var adakla? ghabru nako,
var-khali derivative, sagla ghe to.
tari indeterminate? punha chalav,
L'Hopital banger — hishob chukav!
lyrics_gu: zero over zero par atakya? gabaraao nahi,
upar niche derivative, lai lo sahi.
to y indeterminate? farithi chalaavo,
L'Hopital banger — hisaab chukaavo!
lyrics_bhajan_sa: zero over zero — upari adhaha derivative lehi,

formula: lim(x,y)→(a,b) f = L along EVERY path
concept: A multivariable limit exists only if every path gives the same value L.
lyrics_en: Every path to a-b must agree,
approach from all sides for the limit to be.
One value L, no matter the way —
that's continuity on a 3D display.
lyrics_hi: har raaste se a-b tak pahucho,
sabhi directions se ek hi value soocho.
ek hi L, chaahe raah koi bhi ho,
3D surface pe continuity, slow-mo!
lyrics_bhajan: Har raah se aao (x,y) us thaam,
sab path ek hi L — poora ho kaam,
do raah do uttar to limit kho jaaye,
yahi continuity — man samajh paaye.
lyrics_mr: pratyek vatene a-b paryant pohcha,
sarv directions madhun ekach value bagha.
ekach L, vaat konti hi aso,
3D surface var continuity, slow-mo baso!
lyrics_gu: darek raste a-b sudhi pahoncho,
badhi directions thi ek j value jovo.
ek j L, raste koi pan hoy,
3D surface par continuity, slow-mo joy!
lyrics_bhajan_sa: ekaha eva L — maargaha ko api astu,

concept: Differentiate one variable holding others constant; mixed partials are equal when continuous.
lyrics_en: Hold y still, differentiate x alone,
partial f partial x — one variable, own the zone.
Mixed partials equal, Clairaut makes it known,
f x y equals f y x, full grown.
lyrics_hi: y ko sthir rakho, x pe differentiate,
partial f partial x — ek variable, concentrate.
mixed partials barabar, Clairaut kahe,
f x y barabar f y x rahe.
lyrics_bhajan: Ek variable chalo, baaki sthir rakho,
partial derivative ka prabhu-naam japo,
mixed partial x-y, y-x barabar,
Clairaut ki kripa — gaao nirantar.
lyrics_mr: y sthir theva, x var differentiate,
partial f partial x — ek variable, concentrate.
mixed partials barobar, Clairaut sangto,
f x y barobar f y x rahto.
lyrics_gu: y ne sthir raakho, x par differentiate,
partial f partial x — ek variable, concentrate.
mixed partials barabar, Clairaut kahe,
f x y barabar f y x rahe.
lyrics_bhajan_sa: Om, ekaikam chalam, sthiram cha anyat,

concept: Expand a 2-variable surface: tangent plane, then curvature from second partials.
lyrics_en: Tangent plane rising, approximate it true,
h times f x plus k times f y, the first-order view.
Then curve the surface with the second-order sound,
multi-variable Taylor spinning all around.
lyrics_hi: tangent plane se surface ko chhuo,
h into f x plus k into f y, first order suno.
phir second order se curve ko ghoomao,
do variable ka Taylor, dhun mein jhoomao.
lyrics_bhajan: Do variable ki surface, a-b pe tiko,
h f_x aur k f_y — pehla pad liko,
aadha second partial — curvature samaao,
Taylor do-var ka — bhajan mein gaao.
lyrics_mr: tangent plane ne surface la sparsh kara,
h into f x plus k into f y, first order dhara.
mag second order ne curve la ghumva,
don variable cha Taylor, dhunit jhulva.
lyrics_gu: tangent plane thi surface ne sparsho,
h into f x plus k into f y, first order dharo.
pachhi second order thi curve ne ghumaavo,
be variable no Taylor, dhun ma jhumaavo.
lyrics_bhajan_sa: h f_x cha k f_y — prathamam padam likhitam,

formula: D = rt − s² ; r=f_xx, s=f_xy, t=f_yy
concept: Critical points where fₓ=f_y=0, classified by the Hessian discriminant D.
lyrics_en: f x equals zero, f y equals zero, the critical sign,
now test it with the Hessian, draw the line.
D equals r t minus s squared tells you the fate:
peak, or valley, or a saddle — calculate!
lyrics_hi: f x zero, f y zero, critical sign,
Hessian se test karo, kheencho line.
D barabar r t minus s squared bataaye naseeb,
peak, valley ya saddle — kareeb!
lyrics_bhajan: f_x f_y dono zero — critical sthaan,
D barabar r t minus s square ka gyaan,
D positive r positive to minima paao,
maxima-minima ka rahasya samjhaao.
lyrics_mr: f x zero, f y zero, critical sign,
Hessian ne test kara, odha line.
D barobar r t minus s squared sangte nasheeb,
peak, valley ki saddle — javal kareeb!
lyrics_gu: f x zero, f y zero, critical sign,
Hessian thi test karo, kheencho line.
D barabar r t minus s squared kahe nasib,
peak, valley ke saddle — najik kareeb!
lyrics_bhajan_sa: Om, f_x f_y shunyam — critical sthaanam,
D samaanam r t minus s square jnaanam,
D positive r positive — minima labhyate,

concept: Optimize under a constraint by setting gradients parallel via multiplier λ.
lyrics_en: Constraint on the path, you can't break the wall,
set the gradients parallel, answer the call.
grad f equals lambda grad g, lock the flow,
constrained optimum — that's the way to go.
lyrics_hi: constraint ki deewar, tod na sako,
gradients parallel, jawaab pao.
grad f barabar lambda grad g, flow ko baandho,
constrained optimum — raasta saadho.
lyrics_bhajan: Constraint g zero — prabhu ki maryaada,
grad f barabar lambda grad g — yahi vaada,
dono gradient ek disha mein jaaye,
Lagrange multiplier — bhakt sukh paaye.
lyrics_mr: constraint chi bhint, todata yet nahi,
gradients parallel, uttar milel pahi.
grad f barobar lambda grad g, flow la bandha,
constrained optimum — vaat shodha ani sadha.
lyrics_gu: constraint ni deewaal, todi na shako,
gradients parallel, jawaab melvo.
grad f barabar lambda grad g, flow ne baandho,
constrained optimum — rasto saadho.
lyrics_bhajan_sa: Om, constraint g shunyam — maryaadaa prabhoho,
grad f samaanam lambda grad g — satyam aho,

concept: Spin a 2D region about an axis to sweep out a 3D volume (disk / washer).
lyrics_en: Spin the curve around the line, watch it grow,
disks stacking up in a 3D show.
V equals pi integral f of x squared d x, the beat spins,
volume of revolution — that's how it begins.
lyrics_hi: curve ko axis ke gird ghumao,
disks jama ke 3D dikhao.
V barabar pi integral f of x squared d x, beat spin,
volume of revolution — ab begin!
lyrics_bhajan: Curve ko ghumaao axis ke chaaro or,
pi integral f square — pakdo yeh dor,
disk pe disk jude, volume ban jaaye,
solid of revolution — man harshaaye.
lyrics_mr: curve la axis chya bhovti firva,
disks jamvun 3D dakhva.
V barobar pi integral f of x squared d x, beat spin,
volume of revolution — aata begin!
lyrics_gu: curve ne axis ni aaspaas ghumaavo,
disks bhega kari 3D batavo.
V barabar pi integral f of x squared d x, beat spin,
volume of revolution — have begin!
lyrics_bhajan_sa: pi integral f square — grhnaami drdham ato,

concept: Wrap a curve's arc around an axis to get the lateral surface area.
lyrics_en: Wrap the arc around, the bands of the shell,
slant length d s does the job so well.
S equals two pi integral y root one plus y dash squared d x,
surface of revolution, catchy and complex.
lyrics_hi: arc ko lapet do, shell ke band,
slant length d s kaam karein grand.
S barabar two pi integral y root one plus y dash squared d x,
surface of revolution — catchy complex!
lyrics_bhajan: Arc ko lapeto axis ke paas,
do pi integral f, root one-plus-f-dash-square saath,
surface ka kshetrafal yahi se aaye,
revolution ki mahima — sab gun gaaye.
lyrics_mr: arc la gundala, shell chya band,
slant length d s karte kaam grand.
S barobar two pi integral y root one plus y dash squared d x,
surface of revolution — catchy complex!
lyrics_gu: arc ne vinto, shell na band,
slant length d s kaam kare grand.
S barabar two pi integral y root one plus y dash squared d x,
surface of revolution — catchy complex!
lyrics_bhajan_sa: two pi integral f, root one plus f dash square sahite,

concept: Integration over infinite bounds or through an asymptote, taken as a limit.
lyrics_en: Bounds at infinity, the melody drifts,
a limit takes the stand as the boundary shifts.
Integral a to infinity equals the limit of a to t,
finite means converge, else diverge, you see.
lyrics_hi: infinity pe bounds, dhun bahe,
limit sambhaale jab boundary dhahe.
Integral a to infinity barabar limit a to t,
finite toh converge, warna diverge, dekh le.
lyrics_bhajan: Seema anant tak, ya asymptote paar,
limit t anant — lo prabhu aadhaar,
integral a se t, phir t ko bhejo door,
improper ka uttar mile — bhakti bharpoor.
lyrics_mr: infinity var bounds, dhun vahate,
limit sambhalte jevha boundary dhasalte.
Integral a to infinity barobar limit a to t,
finite tar converge, nahitar diverge, bagh te.
lyrics_gu: infinity par bounds, dhun vahe,
limit sambhaale jyare boundary dhase.
Integral a to infinity barabar limit a to t,
finite to converge, nahi to diverge, jo te.
lyrics_bhajan_sa: limit t ananta — grhnaami prabho note,
integral a to t, punaha t dooram,

concept: Euler's first integral — symmetric, links trig integrals and factorials.
lyrics_en: Euler's first integral, zero to one glide,
B m n equals integral zero to one, x to m minus one, one minus x to n minus one.
Symmetric and soulful, B m n equals B n m,
R and B of the integrals, flowing like a gem.
lyrics_hi: Euler ka pehla integral, zero se one,
B m n barabar integral zero to one, x to m minus one, one minus x to n minus one.
symmetric soulful, B m n barabar B n m,
integrals ka R and B, bahta gem!
lyrics_bhajan: Zero se ek tak, Euler ki daya,
x power m-minus-one, one-minus-x ki chhaya,
power n-minus-one — Beta ka roop,
symmetric sundar — bhajan ki dhoop.
lyrics_mr: Euler cha pahila integral, zero te one,
B m n barobar integral zero to one, x to m minus one, one minus x to n minus one.
symmetric soulful, B m n barobar B n m,
integrals cha R and B, vahta gem!
lyrics_gu: Euler no pahelo integral, zero thi one,
B m n barabar integral zero to one, x to m minus one, one minus x to n minus one.
symmetric soulful, B m n barabar B n m,
integrals no R and B, vehto gem!

concept: The factorial extended to all reals, with Γ(n+1)=nΓ(n) and Γ(½)=√π.
lyrics_en: Factorials continuous, crown of the reals,
Gamma n equals integral zero to infinity, x to n minus one, e to minus x.
Gamma n equals n minus one factorial the recurrence sings,
and Gamma half equals root pi — the secret it brings.
lyrics_hi: factorial continuous, reals ka taaj,
Gamma n barabar integral zero to infinity, x to n minus one, e to minus x.
Gamma n barabar n minus one factorial recurrence gaaye,
aur Gamma half barabar root pi raaz sunaaye.
lyrics_bhajan: Factorial failaaye har sankhya par,
Gamma ka integral — e power minus x bhar,
Gamma n barabar n-minus-one factorial,
Gamma half root pi — gyaan anmol.
lyrics_mr: factorial continuous, reals cha taaj,
Gamma n barobar integral zero to infinity, x to n minus one, e to minus x.
Gamma n barobar n minus one factorial recurrence gaate,
ani Gamma half barobar root pi rahasya sangte.
lyrics_gu: factorial continuous, reals no taaj,
Gamma n barabar integral zero to infinity, x to n minus one, e to minus x.
Gamma n barabar n minus one factorial recurrence gaay,
ane Gamma half barabar root pi rahasya kahevaay.
lyrics_bhajan_sa: Gamma integral — e power minus x tanusu,
Gamma half root pi — jnaanam amrtam, nirmal.

concept: Integrate over a 2D region for the volume under a surface (Fubini).
lyrics_en: Layer upon layer across the plane,
bouncy little pop tune, do it again.
Double integral over R, f of x y, d A, Fubini's delight,
inner then outer, integrate it right.
lyrics_hi: plane pe layer pe layer chadhe,
halki si pop dhun, phir se badhe.
Double integral over R, f of x y, d A, Fubini pyaar,
inner phir outer — integrate, yaar!
lyrics_bhajan: Do dishaon mein jodo, region ke paar,
double integral f — Fubini aadhaar,
dy phir dx, ya dx phir dy,
surface ke neeche volume — prabhu ji.
lyrics_mr: plane var layer var layer chadhe,
halki pop dhun, punha vadhe.
Double integral over R, f of x y, d A, Fubini prem,
inner mag outer — integrate, friend!
lyrics_gu: plane par layer par layer chadhe,
halki pop dhun, farithi vadhe.
Double integral over R, f of x y, d A, Fubini prem,
inner pachhi outer — integrate, friend!
lyrics_bhajan_sa: dy atha dx, athava dx atha dy,
surface adhaha volume — vande prabho, jaya.

formula: ∫∫ f dy dx  ⇄  ∫∫ f dx dy
concept: Sketch the region and swap inner/outer limits to the opposite strips.
ref_en: Mark Ronson ft. Bruno Mars – ‘Uptown Funk’
lyrics_en: Sketch the region, feel the funky bass,
vertical strips to horizontal, change the space.
Swap d y d x to d x d y, re-bound the floor,
change of order groove makes the hard one score.
lyrics_hi: region ko sketch karo, funky bass,
vertical se horizontal, badlo space.
d y d x ko d x d y mein lao,
change of order groove — easy banao.
lyrics_bhajan: Region ko kheencho, man mein dhyaan dharo,
andar-baahar ki seema aaps mein badlo,
dy dx se dx dy ban jaaye,
change of order — ganit muskaaye.
lyrics_mr: region sketch kara, funky bass,
vertical te horizontal, badla space.
d y d x la d x d y madhe aana,
change of order groove — sopa bana na.
lyrics_gu: region sketch karo, funky bass,
vertical thi horizontal, badlo space.
d y d x ne d x d y ma laavo,
change of order groove — saral banaavo.
lyrics_bhajan_sa: dy dx to dx dy bhavati,

formula: ∬ f dx dy = ∬ f |J| du dv ; polar J=r
concept: Transform coordinates and rescale area by the Jacobian determinant |J|.
lyrics_en: New coordinates dropping, don't lose the ground,
scale the area by the Jacobian J, spin it around.
Polar gives J equals r, d A equals r d r d theta,
Jacobian in the bass, transform and go!
lyrics_hi: naye coordinates, zameen na chhoote,
area ko Jacobian J se scale karo, loot le.
polar mein J barabar r, d A barabar r d r d theta,
Jacobian bass mein — transform, chalo!
lyrics_bhajan: Coordinate badlo, nayi drishti paao,
Jacobian determinant se area tolo,
polar mein J barabar r — yaad rakho,
change of variables — prabhu naam japo.
lyrics_mr: nave coordinates, jameen na sute,
